standard-dialogue-after-completing-the-d.npc: Thank you for finding our son, you've done this kingdom a great service.
I do wonder if his father could have done more though. My brother would have had the entire army out searching.
My brother is Lord Shiro Shayzien. He commands the Shayzien Army. A luxury my husband doesn't have.
Maybe it doesn't always have to be that way. Things may well soon be different. Now be on your way, I have things to do.

standard-dialogue-after-completing-a-kin.npc: Isn't this wonderful! My son on the throne. I always knew he'd do great things.

standard-dialogue-after-completing-a-kin.player: Shame about his father though, right?

standard-dialogue-after-completing-a-kin.npc: Oh yes, terrible business. It breaks Artur's heart not to have him around.
Still, always best to focus on the positives I say.
